Union Minister Walks Off Stage During BJP Event in Gurugram

Union Minister Rao Inderjit Singh walked off the stage during a BJP event in Gurugram after questioning the absence of the local MP. The incident occurred mid-speech. Singh reportedly expressed dissatisfaction with the event's organisation and the local leadership's presence. The event was attended by other BJP leaders, including Nitin Nabin.
